request.style: English, African-American spiritual, a slow hushed choir in rich close harmony with a deep bass voice leading, humming between verses, no instruments, reverent and yearning, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jacob lay down with a stone for his pillow
In the wilderness alone
And he dreamed of a ladder set up on the earth
Its top reaching up to the throne

[Chorus]
Angels going up and down, going up and down
Surely the Lord is in this place
And I did not know it
Angels going up and down

[Verse]
And the Lord stood above it and said to him
I am with you wherever you go
I will not leave you until I have done
All the things I have promised you so

[Chorus]
Angels going up and down, going up and down
Surely the Lord is in this place
And I did not know it
Angels going up and down

[Outro]
This is the house of God, this is the gate of heaven
